Metadata.title: Orrery
Metadata.description: Self-hosted control panel for your GitHub repositories

Setup.title: Set up Orrery
Setup.tokenIntro: Enter the setup token printed in the container logs. It proves you operate this server.
Setup.createIntro: Next, create the GitHub App that signs you in and reads your repositories. You will go to GitHub and come back here.
Setup.createPermissions: The app is read-only: metadata, contents, issues, pull requests, actions and organization members.
Setup.doneBody: Install it on the accounts and organizations whose repositories you want to see. Then sign in with GitHub in this browser: the first sign-in becomes the instance admin.

Auth.title: Sign in to Orrery
Auth.intro: Orrery shows what GitHub lets you see. Sign in with the GitHub account you use for your repositories.

Shell.emptyBody: A repository shows up here once it has a .hub.yml file on its default branch and the GitHub App can read it.
Shell.issuesShowingLast: Showing the last valid version until they are fixed.
Shell.issuesNeverValid: Nothing can be shown until they are fixed.
Shell.noWidgets: This page has no widgets yet.

Secrets.title: Secrets of {project}
Secrets.intro: Secrets are write-only: once saved, a value is never shown again. Each one is only ever sent to the hosts it is bound to.
Secrets.errorTitle: The secret could not be saved
Secrets.formHelp: Saving a name that already exists replaces its value and hosts.
Secrets.name: Name
